title: Smoggy Opera, Jade Compass, Glaced Packet
summary: Under a smoggy, golden-hour sky, our protagonist checks on jiffy-rigged plants in a hidden basement, as an opera-like whale-airship drifts above twin scholars, playing and discussing fables. Navigating a crumbling gorge, they offload a packet near a chocked gumball machine, while a ranked ninja beckons, holding a jujube. Goblins glue a mature trumpet for a talky broadcast. In a vile, rust-covered metro lockerroom, harsh light illuminates their cuffed hands and disheveled hairstyle as they use kungfu to impede a nomadic figure. From an elegant ridge, our unoppressed hero surveys the knifed mummy, its antenna like a mustache. Gloried by their flippy ideas, they consider new intrigue and outbound plans to relocate.
